// diagnostic E0960

Jet.ReservedContributionNamespace

A module contribution names something other than a module namespace.

What

A module contribution names something other than a module namespace.

Why

A module contributes to one of the reserved namespaces `env`, `image`, `profile`, or `perf`; an image source names `packages` or `env` the same way.

Fix

Begin the contribution with one of those namespaces, as in `env.name: module { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ReservedContributionNamespace: Tests/UI/module_unknown_namespace.stderr.

Error: Jet.ReservedContributionNamespace: `settings` is not a module namespace
  --> Tests/UI/module_unknown_namespace.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     settings.dev: Env {
    |     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: A module contributes to the reserved namespaces `env` (a dev environment), `image` (a container image), and `profile` (a package generation)
 Fix: Begin the contribution with `env`, `image`, or `profile`
